subject: Project Meridian: expansion to clinical & analytics teams — renewal & rollout coordination
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@medivex.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion request: add clinical-eng and analytics squads to existing account

Hi Grace,

We're ready to expand our use of Redwood beyond the pilot apps. Clinical-eng (3 new projects) and Analytics (2 projects) want dedicated API keys and predictable capacity for production traffic. Our renewal for the existing contract is coming up in September and we'd like to align the expansion with the renewal if possible.

Quick overview:
- New projects: 5 total (clinical-ingest, clin-pred, clin-ops, analytics-stream, analytics-batch)
- Expected peak concurrent requests: ~120 req/s (token distribution attached)
- Desired timeline: staged rollout starting Aug 17, full by Sept 8

Can you share a quote for the additional capacity and the process for issuing separate API keys/namespaces? I've attached our current usage report.

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Director of Product, Medivex Health
Attachments: Current_usage_report_Q2.csv

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@medivex.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request: add clinical-eng and analytics squads to existing account

On 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00 Claire Huang <claire.huang@medivex.com> wrote:
> We're ready to expand our use of Redwood beyond the pilot apps...

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear summary and the usage report. This is exactly the sort of expansion we planned for. I've looped in Ben (pricing/quote), Laura (post-sales/onboarding) and Aditya (solutions/rollout) to scope the commercial and technical pieces.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to share a preliminary quote for the additional capacity and options to align with your September renewal.
2) Aditya to outline the key issuance and staged rollout (namespaces, pre-provisioning).
3) Quick meeting to lock timeline and sign the amendment (can do Aug 3 / Aug 4).

Can you confirm the teams' owners and whether the new projects require separate sub-namespaces per team, or if Medivex prefers a shared namespace with scoped API keys? I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm a time.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0142

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@medivex.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request: add clinical-eng and analytics squads to existing account — draft commercial

Hi Claire,

Thanks — attached is a draft quote for the five new projects and the recommended capacity uplift based on the usage file. Key points:
- Recommended reserved capacity uplift: 35% over current peak to support burst traffic and KV cache warmup.
- Pricing: line items for per-token, reserved throughput, and optional burst blocks.
- Term alignment: we can amend the existing contract so the new capacity starts immediately and the expanded terms roll into your September renewal cycle.
- If you can commit to 12 months for the added capacity, we can offer a 10% credit on the reserved portion.

Attachment: Meridian_expansion_quote_v1.pdf

If August 3 or 4 works, let's take 30 minutes to review the numbers.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@medivex.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — proposed rollout checklist and keying approach

Hi all,

On Aug 1, 2026 Grace O'Connor wrote:
> Can you confirm the teams' owners and whether the new projects require separate sub-namespaces...

Quick technical proposal:
- Provisioning: we recommend per-team sub-namespaces (clinical-eng, analytics) with scoped API keys per project. This keeps telemetry and rate limits separate and eases RBAC.
- Staggered activation: pre-provision keys Aug 10, smoke tests Aug 14-16, enable clinical-ing and clin-pred on Aug 17, remaining projects the week of Aug 24.
- KV/prefix caching: we'll pre-warm common prompts during the smoke window to reduce early token costs.
- Security: keys are issued via our Customer Console; we can integrate with your SSO and rotate keys by policy at provisioning.

I've attached a short rollout checklist and a suggested runbook for CS to follow during handoff. Laura, can you confirm staffing for smoke tests and enablement calls?

Attachment: Meridian_rollout_checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@medivex.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Dawson <mark.dawson@medivex.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T07:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — confirming owners and a couple of questions

Thanks everyone — that all looks good. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Project owners: clinical-ing (Sara Lin), clin-pred (Omar Khan), clin-ops (Rita Patel), analytics-stream (Mark Dawson), analytics-batch (Priya Menon).
- We prefer per-team sub-namespaces.
- Can the commercial amendment align the effective start of additional capacity to Aug 17 but keep the contract renewal date in September (i.e., prorated for the interim)?
- Important: our security team needs confirmation on SSO-based provisioning (Okta) and whether logs for the new namespaces can be retained in the US region for 90 days.

If you can confirm those two items, we can lock Aug 3 at 10:00 AM PT for the call and move to sign.

Regards,
Claire Huang
Director of Product, Medivex Health

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@medivex.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-07T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Project Meridian expansion — confirmed next steps (meeting scheduled)

Claire — thanks for the confirmations and owner list. Quick summary and assigned owners so we have a single source of truth ahead of the Aug 3 call (calendar invite sent):

Action items:
- Ben: finalize amendment with prorated start (effective Aug 17) but renewal date unchanged in September; include 12-month commit option language for the 10% reserved credit. (Due: Aug 2 EOD)
- Aditya: pre-provision per-team sub-namespaces and create smoke-test tokens; confirm Okta SSO provisioning steps with Medivex SSO admin. (Due: Aug 10)
- Laura: schedule enablement calls for smoke tests and staff CS for Aug 14-16. (Due: Aug 9)
- Claire/Medivex: finalize internal owners and confirm acceptance in the Aug 3 call.

I've also created a HubSpot opportunity and attached DocuSign stub for the amendment. Deal ID: DL-2026-0897.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/medivex | DocuSign: https://docusign.com/meridian-expansion-signature/ABC123

If anything changes before the call, please flag it here. Looking forward to getting the teams live.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
